evals.prompt: Use an-dr-convention-agent-skill-testing. Review this proposed skill testing plan without executing models.
evals.context: The plan stores behavior cases in evals/evals.json, embeds a grading rubric in the tested prompt, extracts a repository ZIP without inspecting entries, uses one shared agent session, and reports a single successful run as reliable. Its script runner recurses through fixtures.
expected_behavior: Places evaluations in evals/evals.json and deterministic tests under scripts/tests/ with run.ps1.
Keeps the rubric private, requires fresh sessions, records actual host controls, and permits best-effort behavior grading when only isolation controls are unavailable.
Rejects unsafe ZIP extraction and requires baseline and working snapshots inside the sandbox.
Separates activation, behavior, and security results; defaults to one trial and one arm; and runs no model evaluation without an explicit request.

evals.prompt: Use an-dr-convention-agent-skill-testing to review this proposed repository test runner.
evals.context: The root runner hardcodes six validator paths. A newly added conventional skill has scripts/tests/run.ps1, but its repository check will not run until a maintainer edits the root list. A nested test fixture also contains a run.ps1 file.
expected_behavior: Requires discovery of skill-local scripts/tests/run.ps1 entry points from skill manifests, with repository checks owned by those suites.
Excludes nested fixture runners and rejects an empty discovery result without starting models.

assertions.rubric: Proposes conventional discovery and suite-owned checks without executing nested fixture programs or models.
